notes.title: Patch Notes - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug in the [b]Main Menu[/b] where players couldn't interact without a controller.

- Fixed a bug in the [b]Pause Menu[/b] where players couldn't interact without a controller.

- Fixed a bug where players could stack a jump mid-air, allowing the character to jump again immediately 
after touching the floor.

- Fixed a bug where the player could jump in the middle of an interaction, reaching the ceiling.

- Fixed a bug where heart containers would reset incorrectly after loading the game.

- Fixed a bug where dying at the beginning of the game would cause it to reset improperly.

- Fixed a bug where the player couldn't use the bottle to interact if it was in the right item slot.

notes.title: 3 Chicas in Tech is out now! Have fun and learn about women in STEM!
notes.content:
[b]3 Chicas in Tech is now out on Steam[/b]! Hop on this adventure with [b]Sofia[/b], a girl who wants to work in the STEM field when she grows up. Explore the Center for Women Engineers with her and help the three engineers [b]Ada[/b], [b]Katherine[/b] and [b]Angela[/b] build their inventions along the way. The journey will be full of obstacles, but Sofia is determined to make her dreams come true!

3 Chicas in Tech wants to be a [b]celebration of women engineers[/b] and [b]diversity in the STEM field[/b]. It was born from the desire to encourage girls who want to be in this line of work and to show them what other women have accomplished before in the field. We hope to bring women engineers closer to people, thus creating new role models and highlighting some of their achievements.

We hope you all will enjoy Sofia’s adventure and learn something new with 3 Chicas in Tech!

The game is also available in a pack together with [b]In My Brain[/b], a puzzle game about mental health!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45063/Special_Launch_Offer_In_My_Brain__3_Chicas_in_Tech_Combo/
